name: oid4vci-issuer
description: A minimal OID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) issuer service. Content-agnostic: takes an already-built unsigned Verifiable Credential from a coordinator, hands the pre-authorized-code/token/credential protocol dance with the wallet, and delegates signing to a digitalcredentials/signing-service instance.
author: Samuel Rinnetmäki <samuel@iki.fi>
